## What this PR does

## Owner area
- [ ] Branch name starts with my member prefix (m1/ m2/ m3/ m4/)
- [ ] I only changed files in my own area (the ownership check passes)
- [ ] If I touched another member's file, the owner approved and added the label `cross-owner-approved`

## Checks
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or .env files committed
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or contracts changed
- [ ] Shared contract (packages/shared) change? Tagged the affected members
